entry.title: Upcoming Outage – Learner Management (ODMT) - Tuesday, 02 Sep 2026 15:00 - 03 Sep 2026 16:00 PT
entry.content:
Sep 3, 16:00 PDT
Completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Sep 2, 15:35 PDT
In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Sep 2, 15:32 PDT
Scheduled - Upcoming Outage – Learner Management (ODMT)



Date & Time:

Deployment Activities: Tuesday, 02 Sep 2026 15:00 – 16:00 PT
Validation activities: will continue until Wednesday, 03 Sep 2026 16:00

What is being deployed and why?


What is being deployed and why? We are deploying updates to the Official Document Management Tool (ODMT) to reflect a recent leadership change in the College of Graduate Studies and to resolve a data transmission issue affecting XML transcripts. These changes ensure Program Completion Letters reflect current signatory and contact information, and that receiving institutions get complete transcript data.

Key Improvements


ODMT



Update Confirmation Enrollment Letters templates according to new signatures.
Restored 3 missing transmission data attributes on XML transcripts.


Who's impacted?


Primary Users:

Enrolment Services Records staff processing transcript requests, parchments, and courier shipments.
Graduate Studies staff managing document orders and FedEx shipping.
Secondary Impact:
ODMT users (students and staff) will experience temporary inability to access ODMT during the 60-minute maintenance window
Students with financial holds will now be correctly identified in the system
Students receiving official transcripts will receive properly formatted documents
System Impact & Availability
During Maintenance (60 minutes):
ODMT will display a maintenance page to all users
Students cannot access ODMT to place new orders or check order status
Staff cannot process orders or update tracking information
SCT will remain available


After Maintenance:

Updated Program Completion Letter template and corrected XML transcript output will be immediately available.


Detailed Feature Information
What is the new way of doing things?
For Enrolment Services Records Staff / Students (ODMT):
Before:


Outdated Confirmation Enrollment Letters



After:


Updated Confirmation Enrollment Letter according to new templates.

entry.title: Zoom Update Issue on UBC Owned Windows Devices
entry.content:
Aug 31, 10:00 PDT
Resolved - The Zoom Update issue has been resolved. Users who are still experiencing issues should re-install manually by first uninstalling "Zoom and Zoom plug-in for Outlook" through Software Center then re-installing it. A restart may be required before attempting re-install.

Aug 19, 15:21 PDT
Identified - A newer version of the "Zoom and Zoom plug-in for Outlook" program has been added to the Software Center which will remediate this issue.

Users who are still experiencing the issue of Zoom prompting for administrator credentials should restart their computer. Once restarted, the new version of Zoom should be installed automatically when the computer is next asleep or locked but still connected to the internet.

The latest Zoom client could also be installed manually by first uninstalling "Zoom and Zoom plug-in for Outlook" through Software Center then re-installing it.

Aug 17, 16:47 PDT
Investigating - Some Zoom users on Windows clients may have experienced a problem where Zoom requests to perform an update, but is unable to complete. This would prevent users from using the Zoom application to attend or schedule Zoom meetings until the update is completed.

The cause of this issue has been identified and a remediation is in progress of being deployed. The update will happen automatically and no action should be required of the user.
